name: Goal progress
description: Show how close a fundraiser, appeal or sales target is: a thermometer, progress bar or ring with the amount raised, percentage, milestones, supporter count and a deadline countdown. Celebrates with confetti when the goal is reached. Type the total in, or connect a Google Sheet, form responses or REST API so it updates itself.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline
params.default: Fill the shelves at Riverside Food Pantry
params.help: The big line. Up to three lines on screen.

params.name: kicker
params.label: Campaign name
params.help: Small line above the headline. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: thanks
params.label: Thank-you line
params.default: Every gift stays in Riverside. Thank you for standing with your neighbours.
params.help: Along the bottom. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Optional. Shown above the headline.

params.name: style
params.label: Gauge
params.help: A wide strip zone always uses the progress bar.

params.name: raised
params.label: Amount raised so far
params.help: Used when no data source is connected, or when it has no amount column.

params.name: supporters
params.label: Number of supporters
params.help: 0 hides it. A donations-log data source counts its rows instead.

params.name: currency
params.label: Currency code
params.help: Three letters: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY… Leave empty for plain numbers (hours, books, sign-ups).

params.name: unit
params.label: Unit (without a currency)
params.help: Shown after plain numbers, e.g. "books" or "km". Ignored when a currency is set.

params.name: milestones
params.label: Milestones
params.help: One per line: Amount | Label. Up to 10, between 0 and the goal. Leave empty for none.
params.default:
10000 | New shelving
25000 | Walk-in freezer
40000 | Delivery van

params.name: deadline
params.label: Deadline
params.help: A date (2026-12-24), a date and time (2026-12-24T17:00), or month-end, quarter-end, year-end. Leave empty to hide the countdown.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone of the deadline
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The words, numbers and dates on screen, for example en-US, de-DE or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: goal_text
params.label: Text under the amount
params.help: {target} is replaced by the goal. Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: percent_label
params.label: Caption: percentage
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: supporters_label
params.label: Caption: supporters
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: countdown_label
params.label: Caption: countdown
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: ended_label
params.label: Text once the deadline has passed
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: next_text
params.label: Next-milestone line
params.help: {milestone}, {amount} and {remaining} are filled in. Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: celebrate_text
params.label: Text when the goal is reached
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in text in the screen's language, or type - to hide it.

params.name: source
params.label: Live total data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, form responses, CSV, REST API or Manual table. See the README for the layouts it understands.

params.name: amount_col
params.label: Amount column or field
params.help: Case and punctuation don't matter. A donations log can use its Amount column.

options.label: Automatic (one row = the total; many rows = add them up)
Add up every row (a donations log)

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The top of the gauge fill, the amount and the reached milestones.

params.name: accent2
params.label: Second fill colour
params.help: The fill fades from this colour into the accent.

params.name: animate
params.label: Animate (fill on load, confetti at the goal)
params.help: Turn off on very slow players.
